name: Soho Holly Corporation Class A
summary: Soho Holly Corporation's core operations center on commercial trade, encompassing both international and domestic markets. The company's export arm specializes in goods such as apparel, recreational items, and fishing apparatus. Conversely, its import division focuses on sourcing medical devices and a range of chemical products. Within the domestic sphere, its commercial dealings include coal and various chemical substances. Beyond these trading endeavors, Soho Holly also engages in cultural and investment activities. Established in 1979, the firm's main offices are located in Nanjing, China.
